in_english.name: Rukhaya
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rukhaya originates from the Arabic root 'ر-خ-ي' (r-kh-y), meaning beautiful girl or good woman. It carries connotations of serenity and beauty. Historically, names derived from this root have been used in various Muslim cultures to signify desirable qualities in a person.
